title: dataobj-sql: archive rule split and live-to-archive join
description: Streams matched by an archive rule are served from gzipped OTLP JSON archive objects as archive_logs; the rest are live data objects (logs). Provisioned by `make grafana-sql`.

panels.title: Archived lines per 5m by service_name
panels.description: archive_logs is served by the archive scanner from gzipped OTLP JSON objects (data/archive, the archive-and-replay layout). The time filter selects five-minute partitions; nothing else is indexed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '5m'), service_name AS metric, count(*) AS lines
FROM archive_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Live versus archived lines per 5m
panels.description: Two queries, one per table. The archive rule {service_name="nginx"} and {service_name="web-server", env="dev"} decides which streams went where.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '5m'), 'live (logs)' AS metric, count(*) AS lines
FROM logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", '5m'), 'archived (archive_logs)' AS metric, count(*) AS lines
FROM archive_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Archived lines for traces that errored live (join on trace_id)
panels.description: Live-to-archive correlation: trace ids seen on error lines in the live logs table, looked up in the archive. The time filter is pushed down to both scans; the join itself runs in DataFusion.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a."timestamp", a.service_name, a.trace_id, a.message
FROM archive_logs a
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT trace_id FROM logs
      WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND level = 'error' AND trace_id IS NOT NULL) l
  ON a.trace_id = l.trace_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 100
